page.overview:
Who is Elayna?

Elayna was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as Keeper of the Chronicles, and briefly as Amyrlin Seat around .

Given her extreme natural weakness in the White Tower to the point that she cannot effectively participate in any combat without the use of objects of the One Power, Elayna's natural strength in the One Power likely sits at around , the level of Daigian Moseneillin, the weakest ever known Aes Sedai from the primary world. This is only an estimation, as the Mirror World that Elayna is from may have different standards for an Aes Sedai.

As a child, Elayna was once trapped in a collapsing cave during one of her adventures. She remembered this experience during her test to be raised Accepted at the White Tower, during the first experience with the silver arches. She then experienced being trapped in the basement of a prominent Darkfriend, and being sent to Fal Dara to stand against Shadowspawn as a full Aes Sedai. The Mistress of Novices of the time, of the Blue Ajah, deemed that she had passed the test, and raised her to Accepted.

Elayna was eventually raised to the shawl and chose the Brown Ajah, although she was as weak as possible for an Aes Sedai to be. She was a student of ter'angreal and used them to raise her abilities in the One Power to the extent that it raised her own political standing within the White Tower.
